name: HIGH FIBRE MUESLI
ingredients_raw: Multigrain 90.8% (Whole Rolled Oats (60.9%), No Added Sugar Whole Wheat Flakes 29.9% (Wheat, Iodised Salt, Cereal Extract, Antioxidants (INS 322 (i) & INS 307 b))), Sweetener (INS 965 - Maltitol), Dried Apples (1%), Lemon Powder & Antioxidant (INS 307b), Flavours (Natural & Nature Identical Flavouring Substances). Polyols may have laxative effect. Allergen Advice: Contains Oats, Wheat, Barley & Soy. May Contain Nut.
